# the FLAG DEFINITIONS it splits on -- the algebra would hold for constant flags,

# leaving them provable.  The module body is separately pinned by the census
# --- GprocVI: the V->VI hop, admitted to the closure 2026-08-05 (run 26) ----
# gproc_V_VI_eq is the deliverable: Pr over Gproc_V = Pr over Gproc_VI for the
# T3 event.  MM45 proves its TRH/TRCO branches over _VI, not _V, so without this
# hop the T3 reduction byequiv has no alignable left-hand side.  The chain below
# it is pinned too because the hop is only as good as the Merkle equivalence and
# the keygen correspondence it rests on.
# The DEPLOYED-SCOPE facts.  Pinned because their VALUE is entirely in what they
# say: a name-only check would let `! (c <= c10_q_s)` be weakened to `true` and
# every other phase would still pass.  Note c10_q_s (= MAX_SLOT_USES) appears
# ONLY in conclusions here -- it is never a hypothesis, and nothing certified
# requires this file, so the deployment cap is NOT imported into the model.
# The six scope pins added on promotion covered 6 of 18 lemmas and 0 of 6
# ops -- so twelve statements and every op VALUE were unpinned inside the
# very file that quarantines the deployment cap.  A value swap
# (op c10_p_tgts : int = 262656 -> 65536) moved NO pin.  Now every
# declaration in that file is pinned; PHASE 1g additionally makes adding
# Every top-level statement in all 38 certified roots (34 closure members + the four
# base roots) is now pinned by digest.  Motivation: an adversarial review found that a
# NEW certified statement is structurally invisible to the gate -- PHASE 1c iterates
# THIS MANIFEST, not the source files, so a lemma that was never pinned is simply
# absent, and absence is invisible to a loop reading the manifest.
# PINS ALONE DO NOT CLOSE THAT.  They stop a pinned statement from CHANGING; they do
# not stop an 897th statement from APPEARING.  The other half is PHASE 1h
# (tools/stmt_coverage.py), which enumerates statements FROM THE FILES and asserts each
# has a row here, with a committed EXPECT_STMTS total.  Read the two together:
#   PHASE 1c  manifest -> files   a pinned statement cannot silently CHANGE
#   PHASE 1h  files -> manifest   a statement cannot silently APPEAR unpinned
# axiom / declare axiom pin through the op: path -- digest() matches only
# A pred body is pure logical content usable as a lemma HYPOTHESIS, and it was
# pinnable by NEITHER digest path: digest() takes only lemma/theorem/equiv/hoare/
# phoare, and digest_op() lacked `pred`.  So statements naming a pred digested only
# the TOKEN -- appending a conjunct to the body installed that hypothesis in every
# statement using it with zero pin, coverage or census delta.  That is exactly the
# attack PHASE 1g exists to stop, landing through a surface no phase watched.
# Coverage originally enumerated only the 38 GATE ROOTS, but the certified cone
# is 45 files.  The 79 statements in the 7 transitively-required files were pinned
# by NEITHER check -- not by PHASE 1c (no manifest row) and not by PHASE 1h (not
# enumerated) -- so one could change, or appear, with no delta anywhere.  Note one
# of the seven is cdrafts-split/FORS_C.ec: project code, not vendored library.
# --- DEFINITIONS in the 7 non-root cone files (2026-08-20) ---
# A BODIED op is pure logical content that NOTHING watched: cert_cone.py skips any
# op/const/type whose declaration has a body (a definition, not a parameter), and
# PHASE 1h enumerates only statements.  MEASURED: redefining
# cdrafts-split/FORS_C.ec::predC_fors -- the FORS+C GATE PREDICATE -- to `true`
# left the digest of the lemma carrying it (mco_C_predC) IDENTICAL and coverage
# still reporting full coverage.  Nothing moved.  These pins fix that for the 7
# files this change is about.  SCOPE, STATED: this pins CHANGES to these
# definitions; nothing yet FORCES a new definition to be pinned, and the same
# hole spans all 45 cone files (661 op/const/abbrev, of which 90 are not
# pinnable by the current tool: 84 resolve to None, 6 are genuinely AMBIGUOUS).
# 2026-09-15: the row above was on TWO identical rows from 92ecb63 (2026-08-20) until today, so
# EXPECT_PINS was one pin high and PHASE 1c counted it twice.  The generator was not committed;
# neither stmt_coverage.py nor digest_op produces it.  PHASE 1c now refuses duplicate keys.
